title: Crane NXT Announces Dates for Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Release and Earnings Call
summary: WALTHAM, Mass., Jan. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Crane NXT, Co. (NYSE: CXT), a premier industrial technology company, today announced its schedule for the company’s fourth quarter and full year 2025 results. Earnings Release: Wednesday, February 11, 2026, after close of market by public distribution. To access the earnings release, please visit the Investors section of Crane NXT’s website at www.cranenxt.com . Earnings Call: Thursday, February 12, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. To access the webcast, please visit the Investors section of Crane NXT’s website at www.cranenxt.com . The archived webcast will be available on the company’s website. About Crane NXT, Co. Crane NXT is a premier industrial technology company that provides trusted technology solutions to secure, detect, and authenticate what matters most to its customers.
